UAE equities a 'hidden gem': Emaar (PE ~10-11 vs Indian comps 35-40), Salik toll monopoly, banks, Lulu IPO; Europe (ASML, Louis Vuitton, Novo Nordisk) as currency + legacy-brand hedge. Real estate: 7 Goa villas/airbnbs, 2 Dubai Business Bay apartments (6-7% tax-free rental yield), waiting for the interest-rate cycle bottom before buying more anywhere.
